endpoints.summary: Get all data stores with pagination

Create a new data store from an existing data model.
First-level primitive attributes become typed columns; complex attributes become JSON columns.

Create a new data store by inferring its column schema from a JSON payload or URL.
Top-level properties become typed columns. At least one must be designated as a primary key by name.

Get all restricted data stores with pagination.
Works signed in and anonymously: an anonymous caller is scoped by the owner of the public, enabled
form it passes in formTemplateId, looked up in formWorkspaceId (or the workspace header when absent);
without a form template it receives an empty page.
Modify a column in a data store (rename, retype, or update constraints)
Get the internal data model associated with a data store
Download a completed CSV export job
Start a CSV export job for a data store
Download failed rows for a completed CSV import job
Import CSV data into a data store
Delete rows from a data store from the viewer
Add one or more rows to a data store from the viewer
Update rows in a data store from the viewer

Get paginated rows from a data store for the data viewer.
The optional body carries a recursive filter tree with AND/OR grouping and arbitrary nesting,
plus multi-column sorting, with columns given as display names.
Delete a data store by id
Get a data store by id
Delete one or more data store rows for form instance operations.
Add one or more rows to a data store for form instance operations.
Update a single data store row for form instance operations.

Get paginated rows from a data store for form instance operations.
The optional body carries a recursive filter tree with AND/OR grouping and arbitrary nesting,
plus multi-column sorting, with columns given as display names — the same read capability the
viewer and the Data Store connector have.
Create a signing envelope from a PDF dropped into a form's signing element.

Create the signing envelope of the designer's document of a form's signing element, seeded
with the designer's signers and blocks. Such an element takes no upload.
Discard a DRAFT: it is deleted with its document (Remove document / Cancel signing).
Envelope with spots, parties, and derived effective status.
DRAFT-only update of spots, signers, and order (echo RowVersion from the last read).

Stream a document rendition: current (default), signed, source, or my-step -
the caller's step-scoped view (their order group and earlier; parties only, 404 otherwise).
The signer's scoped session view (marks first view). Party membership is the boundary.
Decline signing; the envelope stops circulating and the sender is notified.
Sign: applies the adopted signature to every spot assigned to the caller.
Send for signing: freezes spots/parties, activates the first order group, dispatches emails.
Create the envelope from the PDF the form's signing element holds; returns the access token once.

Create the envelope of the designer's document of the form's signing element, with the
blocks of the signer's slots; returns the access token once.
Discard the DRAFT: it is deleted, with its document and the signer's details.
Envelope with spots, its one party, and derived effective status.
DRAFT-only update of the signer's own spots (parties and order mode in the payload are ignored).
Stream a rendition: current (default), signed, or source; my-step reads as current.
The signer's session view (their own spots and turn).
Sign: applies the drawn signature to every spot of the signer; a replay returns 200 with current state.
Send after the public submit, bound to the instance it created (of this envelope's form only).

Stream the PDF the form's designer attached to its signing element: the document the
person filling it starts from. The form must be enabled, published and public.
Store the designer's PDF for a signing element of the form template.

Stream a template's signing document: one the form keeps as its document, or - for a
submission made before it was replaced - one its submission formId keeps.
Validate a crontab expression and preview its next occurrences
